[P3] Use the composed-test suffix for both converted suites

This suite and `with-durable-execution.plugin-lifetime.test.ts` now exercise multiple real SDK components through a fake transport, which `TESTING.md` classifies as composed testing. Root `AGENTS.md`, Tests rule 2, assigns that class the `*.composed.test.ts` suffix. Keeping the unit-test filenames misclassifies these suites and prevents discovery by the documented composed-test suffix. Rename both converted files accordingly.
